Test Case: Free Tier — Feature Access & Usage Limits
Preconditions: Tenant set to Free (L0) via Superadmin
Test Steps:
1. Log into Superadmin > Tenants > select tenant
2. Set tier to Free (L0)
3. Log into Client Console as tenant
4. Attempt to send messages and start conversations
5. Attempt to access Lead Capture, Form Capture, Human Handoff
Expected Result: Limited to 50 messages/month; Max 10 conversations/month; Lead Capture and Form Capture NOT accessible; Human Handoff NOT accessible; Only 1 channel available
